description_en: Modifies the routing protocol of a port
description_zh: 调用ModifySagPortRouteProtocol修改端口路由协议
kebab_example: aliyun smartag modify-sag-port-route-protocol --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-whfn0000 --smart-ag-sn sag32a300000 --port-name 2 --vlan 2 --route-protocol STATIC --remote-ip 192.XX.XX.1 --remote-as 65535 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySagPortRouteProtocol

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the SAG device associated with the SAG instance
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: smart_ag_sn

parameters.help_en:
The routing protocol. Valid values:

- **STATIC**: uses a static routing protocol.

- **OSPF**: uses the Open Shortest Path First protocol (OSPF).

- **BGP**: uses the Border Gateway Protocol (BGP)
parameters.help_zh:
路由协议。取值：

- **STATIC**：静态路由协议。
- **OSPF**：OSPF动态路由协议。
- **BGP**：BGP动态路由协议
parameters.name: route_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the peer device.

> You must set this parameter when you enable BGP
parameters.help_zh:
对端IP地址。

>启用BGP路由协议时需输入
parameters.name: remote_ip

parameters.help_en:
The BGP autonomous system number (ASN) of the peer device.

> You must set this parameter when you enable BGP
parameters.help_zh:
对端BGP自治系统编号。

>启用BGP路由协议时需输入
parameters.name: remote_as
